title: Lesson 1 Checkpoint — Can / Can't
description: Show what you learned about can / can't. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can express ability and inability with can and can't.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Can / Can't: Can + base verb (no -s): I can swim. | She can drive.

questions.question: Complete: ___ can swim.
questions.explanation: Can + base verb (no -s): I can swim. | She can drive.

questions.question: True or false: "I can swim." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: I ___'t drive.
questions.explanation: Can + base verb (no -s): I can swim. | She can drive.
